body:
T244's slice 1 merged one PR before T245's refs landed, and the shelf shows it. Three defects against the now-landed section-51 doctrine (a prop is a reference or a primitive, never both):
- person.follows and event.attending: primitive-writable 'who' props, no expand, no edge verb - the fossil path is the ONLY write path.
- org.members: the correct section-14 linkOrg verb exists, but members stays in writable, so the PrimitiveValue argument is open beside it.

The frozen-rail constraint, mapped exactly: T244 froze test/cli/stock-depth.test.ts and stock-install.test.ts. stock-depth WRITES follows as a primitive (person(entity, follows: "person:bob")) and asserts the flat read (follows: ["person:bob"]) - the frozen rail asserts the fossil path as correct behavior, the T143 shape. It also drives linkOrg(field: "members"), which requires members writable today. attending is touched by NO frozen rail. The pin tables (stock-pin.test.ts, stock-deps.test.ts, graph.ts tables) are UNFROZEN.

Therefore two phases, two PRs:

PHASE A (no frozen file touched, ships immediately):
1. Section-14 linkEntityImpl becomes refs-aware: a refs-declared field passes without writable (the refs declaration is the authorization, exactly as section 51 rules for its own verbs). This keeps frozen linkOrg green with members OFF writable.
2. org.members: refs { role: "members" (MUST match the existing expand role so section-14-written edges keep resolving), reciprocal { role: "memberOf", context: "memberOf" } }; members off writable.
3. event.attending: refs { role: "attending", reciprocal: { role: "attends", context: "attending" } } plus an expand to ShallowPerson (role "attending") so attendees read nested; attending off writable.
4. person.follows: UNTOUCHED in phase A (frozen rail owns it).
5. Pin/dep tables and canonical hashes updated in the same change (unfrozen). A store that installed the OLD stock now draws the divergence warning on install comparisons - by design, named in the PR.

PHASE B (the ceremony, two small PRs):
6. scripts/rail-renames.json gains the declared substitutions for stock-depth.test.ts: the primitive follows write becomes linkperson_follows(entity, target), and - IF verification shows the read changes - the flat assertion becomes the new resolved shape. Myk merges the declaration; the edit PR then applies mechanically.
7. person.follows: refs { role: "follows", reciprocal: { role: "followedBy", context: "followers" } }, off writable. Decide WITH MEASUREMENT whether follows keeps flat reads (refs without expand) or gains a ShallowPerson expand: first VERIFY what an entity pointer resolves to under EVERY() with no expand - if it renders as the bare id, refs-without-expand keeps the frozen read assertion true and the substitution list shrinks to the write line alone.

Acceptance criteria: in the working spec at .adlc/specs/52-stock-refs.md, each naming its rail. Frozen files stay byte-identical in phase A; rails-guard-ci must pass.

Merge tier: phase A repairs the shelf to the landed section-51 doctrine - but it changes shipped registrations and the section-14 verb's authorization rule, so Myk merges both PRs. He has ordered this front-of-line.
title: The stock shelf learns refs - fossils closed, edges typed, one frozen rail evolved
